name: shopo-ai
description: Price intelligence and explainable product trust analysis across online marketplaces

scripts.dev-all: concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run python-ai"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:python
scripts.test:python: ".\python-ai\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m unittest discover -s python-ai/tests -p test_*.py || python -m unittest discover -s python-ai/tests -p test_*.py

author: Syed Ahmad Mujtaba Shah and Muhammad Waseel
